_status: EXISTS — the real shape of an experience config read by src/experiences/private/PrivateWorldAdapter.js (validateConfig). Remove _status when you copy it to assets/vr-worlds/private/: any field not in the list refuses the whole config. The worlds and template must already be rated private; the presets, chip and anchor must exist (PlaygroundMoodPresets, the venue template). This example uses the cabaret's real ids so it validates as written.
